gbm_population_evidence.quote: The subject has been newly diagnosed with glioblastoma (GB) based on preoperative neuroimaging (contrast-enhanced brain MRI ± amino acid-based PET/CT) and confirmed by intraoperative histopathological examination of the tumor.

candidate_evidence.quote: The Elekta Xoft® Axxent® Electronic Brachytherapy (eBx®) System is a device that delivers high-dose-rate radiation.
Subsequently, patients will receive standard chemoradiotherapy according to the Stupp protocol (2005):

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Fifteen patients (male and female) with newly diagnosed glioblastoma who meet the inclusion/exclusion criteria

role_evidence.quote: Chemotherapy: Daily oral temozolomide (75 mg/m²) during EBRT.

coder_notes: Investigational intervention is intraoperative balloon electronic brachytherapy (device/radiotherapy), registered as BIOLOGICAL but not a drug. Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but the protocol text says all patients receive Stupp chemoradiotherapy, so listed as soc_backbone. No pharmacological candidate.
